scope: Scalar species reference-state cp/R, h/(R*T), s/R evaluators and dimensional cp/h/s conveniences only. This is not a translation of complete source files or the complete Cantera API.

units.reference_pressure: Pa; stored as metadata, no pressure correction
units.Shomate_coefficients: Conventional A..G: cp and s expressions in J/mol/K; enthalpy expression in kJ/mol; reduced t = T/1000
units.ConstCp_inputs: t0 K, h0 J/kmol, s0 J/kmol/K, cp0 J/kmol/K
units.Mu0_inputs: h0 at 298.15 K in J/kmol; mapping of temperature K to Gibbs energy J/kmol

equations: Integrated s/R including a0*log(T) and a6

methods: Packed constructor coefficient layout and adjacent-bound check
translations.boundary: T equal to a region lower bound selects that upper region; extrapolation selects first or last region

behavioral_choices_and_limits: Public Python constructors differ from Cantera C++ and Cython constructor signatures; documented packed helpers are provided for NASA7, NASA9 and Shomate.
All evaluators require positive finite temperatures, finite coefficients and sensible metadata; these explicit Python validation checks are stricter than unchecked C++ evaluation paths.
Out-of-range positive finite temperatures extrapolate; min/max temperatures do not clamp or reject evaluations.
Normal-domain mathematical expressions and evaluation order are preserved; cross-language floating-point or math-library equality is not guaranteed bit-for-bit.
NASA9 packed input preserves the upstream 0.0001 K adjacent-bound tolerance; its Python normalized metadata uses successive lower boundaries, which does not alter property region selection.
Mu0 initialization corresponds to a fresh source object; source repeated-setParameters accumulation behavior is not exposed. Reconstruct the Python object after changing Gibbs data.
Standard-library math is used; the module imports no Cantera, NumPy, SciPy, Cython or extension bindings. This does not mean the Python interpreter or its math library are written in Python.
excluded_methods_and_features: reportHf298, modifyOneHf298, resetHf298 and corresponding mutable enthalpy-offset APIs
Native reportType, reportParameters, getParameters, nCoeffs and temperature-polynomial buffer APIs
Native setParameters and metadata setter API compatibility
SpeciesThermoFactory YAML parsing, arbitrary input-unit conversion and serialization
Species and MultiSpeciesThermo management, mixtures, phase equations of state, pressure corrections, equilibrium, kinetics, transport and solvers
test_coverage: Independent NASA7 constant-cp and all-term values
NASA9 inverse-temperature terms, NASA7 reduction, one/multiple regions and packed ordering
Exact internal-boundary interval selection and outer-range extrapolation
Shomate dimensional factors and all-term evaluation
Constant-cp reference values and temperature changes
Independent finite-difference dh/dT = cp and ds/dT = cp/T identities
Mu0 known piecewise-cp reconstruction, Gibbs knots and anchors at first/middle/last temperature
